summary.text: Andy Warren is the Democratic candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 94 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Blair Eddins (R).
His campaign website lists health, equality, education and the environment as its focus areas.

paragraphs.text: Andy Warren advanced to the general election after the March 3, 2026 Democratic primary for District 94 was canceled.
His campaign website describes him as having led local volunteer initiatives supporting families in need and community nonprofits.
The site also says he has advocated for public schools and fair pay for educators.
